exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0-2. (Appendix A)
Total bilirubin \< 1.5 X ULN, unless Gilbert syndrome, in which case direct bilirubin must be \< 1.5 x ULN
AST/ALT \< 2.5 X ULN, unless documented liver involvement by lymphoma, in which case AST/ALT must be \<5 x ULN
Known history of seropositivity for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).
Prior history of another malignancy (except for non-melanoma skin cancer or in situ cervical or breast cancer) unless disease free for at least 2 years.
exclusions.threshold: disease free for at least 2 years

exclusions.source_text: Patients with any one of the following currently on or in the previous 6 months will be excluded: myocardial infarction, congenital long QT syndrome, torsade de pointes, unstable angina, coronary/peripheral artery bypass graft, cardiac arrhythmia (CTCAE grade 3 or higher), clinically significant ECG abnormalities, or cerebrovascular accident.
Patients with New York Heart Association Class III or IV heart failure or known ejection fraction of \<45%.
exclusions.threshold: NYHA class III or IV; EF < 45%

exclusions.source_text: Screening 12-lead ECG showing a baseline QTcF \>470 msec.
